## What AKSI is
AKSI is a browser-native Decision Integrity stack:
Brain RU fusion router, Mind, Crystal memory (Neuro+RAG+HRR), π-Contour seals,
Reality observe-only probes, Swarm WebRTC manual-SDP P2P, Service Worker offline shell.
Not a claim of AGI. Engineering product: local decision path, gate, seal, audit trail.
